## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle commentary on the *Bā dàrén jué jīng* 八大人覺經 ([KR6i0476](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0476), T779) by the Qīng-dynasty Huáyán scholar-monk [續法](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%BA%8C%E6%B3%95) (Xùfǎ = Bǎitíng 柏亭, 1641–1728), one of the principal late-Qīng commentators on Huáyán-school texts. The work is preserved in the Manji *Zoku-zōkyō* (CBETA X37 No. 673).

**Abstract**

Xùfǎ's *shū* (subcommentary / extended exegesis) is markedly fuller than [智旭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E6%97%AD) Zhìxù's shorter *Lüèjiě* ([KR6i0477](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0477)) and reflects the Qīng-period scholastic tendency toward systematic exposition with doctrinal cross-references. Xùfǎ approaches the sūtra through Huáyán-school doctrinal categories: he reads the eight awakenings as a graded sequence of contemplative practices culminating in the bodhisattva's universal vow, and he organises the exposition around the Huáyán *yīzhēn fǎjiè* 一真法界 (one-true-Dharma-realm) doctrine. The work draws on a wide range of canonical and exegetical sources, including the *Avataṃsaka-sūtra*, the *Mahā-prajñā-pāramitā-śāstra*, and the standard Tiāntái *zhì-guān* texts, providing the reader with comprehensive doctrinal context for each of the eight contemplations.

Xùfǎ also produced a much fuller five-fascicle subcommentary on the *Sìshí'èrzhāng jīng shūchāo* 四十二章經疏鈔 ([KR6i0487](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0487)), reflecting his programmatic engagement with the "Three Sūtras of the Buddha-Patriarchs" — the *Sìshí'èrzhāng jīng*, the *Bā dàrén jué jīng*, and the *Yíjiào jīng* — as foundational monastic curriculum texts.
